svg.title: Who does the care work: regional ratios, the childcare policy gap, and Kuwait's domestic workers
svg.desc: Women do 1.7 times men's unpaid care in the Americas, 3.2 times worldwide, and 4.7 times in the Arab States; only 57 of 178 countries guarantee childcare for ages 0 to 2, and the average policy gap is 4.2 years; Kuwait has about 781,000 domestic workers.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
